title: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
slides: What if ChatGPT secretly logs every click?
New feature records mouse movements and typed keys.
Even deleted actions remain in your chat history.
You can pause tracking, but past logs stay.
Check your saved data today—then decide.
thread_text:
1. What if ChatGPT logs everything?

A new feature records mouse movements and typed keys, even when you think you're just browsing.

2. Deleted doesn't mean gone

Actions you erase still stay in your chat history—hidden but accessible.

3. Pause is a false promise

You can stop tracking, but all past logs remain. No reset, no erasure.

4. Your history is a data mine

Those logs can reveal habits, hesitations, and drafts you'd rather forget—if someone gets access.

5. Check your saved data now

Open ChatGPT, review your stored activity, and decide if you trust that record.

script: Imagine every click you make is recorded.

instagram.caption:
ChatGPT now keeps a running log of your clicks and keystrokes inside its chat window—even moments you think are off the record.  

The feature stores mouse movements and typed keys as part of your conversation history. Actions you delete are still saved, just hidden. You can pause the tracking, but everything logged before stays—there's no reset.  

For creators, this means every edit, hesitation, and deleted draft is a retrievable shadow file tied to your account.  

Open ChatGPT right now, check "History," and ask yourself: if someone read that log, what would they learn about your process that you never meant to share? 🖱️⌨️ 🗂️
